authority.cloud: tenant byte delivery, quota, retention, references and product access evidence
authority.core: external source/build identity, content digest, provenance and execution authority
authority.caller: current authenticated tenant/action permission and validated external origin/reference ownership

upload: tenant/actor command replay; reserve quota before conditional S3 PUT; verify complete content before ready
deletion: retention and references checked before deleting state; conditionally replace bytes with a permanent zero-byte S3 fence and verify it before releasing payload quota; late conditional uploads cannot recreate content
cleanup: bounded managed-manifest scan with reference recheck; never delete unmanaged bucket keys
export: verify actual digest, then commit tenant audit before returning bytes; no presigned capabilities
runtime_acceptance: requires actual isolated S3/PostgreSQL/ClamAV, separate tenants, server access logs and exact-version independent review
release_limits: No public API mounting, hosted identity switch, game execution, provenance approval, production key custody or production deployment acceptance. Metadata retention remains an operational gate.
